## Summary and General Analysis
- Moze marks an enemy as "Prey", gains 9 points of Charge and departs from the team. When allies attack the "Prey", he deals Lightning Additional DMG to the enemy target and consumes 1 Charge. Every 3 points of "Charge" consumed, he will launch a Follow-Up Attack on the "Prey". When all Charge stacks are consumed, dispels "Prey" and returns to the team.
- If Moze is the only ally remaining, he cannot use his Skill.

## Notable Investments
 ### E2
- E2 gives him CRIT DMG, helping maintain stat goals.
